description: Teacher v2: hing-roberta-mixed fine-tuned on v1.1 train + 1,202 generated + 2,323 augmented + 4,000 public sentiment rows (intent masked); Stage 1 skipped; selection by validation NLL.
protocol: v1.1 evaluator (reproduces whitepaper v1.1 numbers exactly); calibration on validation; group bootstrap 5,000 resamples seed 0; paired deltas vs v1.1 on identical resamples.
selection_rule: lowest validation NLL (unweighted, both heads, T=1) over all done runs

verdict.summary: New data improves intent and negation scope for the teacher; the gain over v1.1 on the dev test is borderline, and the gain over the Phase 1 teacher is not resolved.
verdict.intent: Test intent macro-F1 0.966 [0.92, 0.99] vs v1.1 0.901: paired +0.071 [-0.007, +0.172], 95.8% of resamples favour teacher v2. Vs the Phase 1 teacher (same encoder, v1.1 data only): +0.040 [-0.028, +0.121], P=0.85 - not resolved on 44 test groups. Stress intent F1 0.933 (v1.1 0.865, Phase 1 teacher 0.852); consistency 95.8%.
verdict.sentiment: Unchanged at the 1.000 ceiling (paired vs v1.1 +0.159 [+0.056, +0.282]).
verdict.negation_scope: Contrast negation-scope intent accuracy 0.90 (Phase 1 teacher 0.70, v1.1 0.65) and the audit error "cancel mat karna sirf order track karke batao" is fixed; 6/10 scope pairs fully correct (errors now mostly sentiment or the "nahi mila" -> not_received keyword bias).
verdict.contrast: 29/40 pairs fully correct (Phase 1 teacher 24, v1.1 10). unseen_affect 9/10 must NOT be read as generalisation: 18 of its affect words were added to training via the generated data.
verdict.remaining_errors: Keyword bias toward not_received for any "... nahi mila"/"late" message (otp nahi mila, feedback about delays), and feedback about packing/delivery routed to operational intents.
verdict.audit: 1 error (Phase 1 teacher 1, v1.1 6): "delivery phir late ghatiya service" track_order -> not_received.
verdict.pseudo_labels: Teacher agrees with gold on ~100% of support rows it was trained on (soft labels there carry little beyond gold) and on 70.9% of the public tweet sentiment labels (out-of-domain, noisy gold). Intent KD mask (max prob >= 0.6) keeps 99.7-100% of support rows.
